methodology.startup: Warm system cache, isolated prepared profile, process launch to usable rendered Prompt Studio. Native readiness emitted after frame; Electron CDP checks editable idea field and two animation frames. Electron timing includes Playwright launch/attachment and userData verification overhead. Observation methods are asymmetric; no cold-cache claim.
methodology.resources: Root plus all current descendants, /proc/smaps_rollup PSS/RSS. CPU user+system delta, one core = 100%. Short-lived processes exiting between samples may be missed. Sampler and harness excluded. Per-run CPU is a time-weighted mean; memory is a per-run median, with summary statistics across runs.
methodology.emptyProjectsFixture: Both displayed inventory models have zero rows. Packaged v15 automatically bootstraps a default project, so its existing exported Zustand store is set to an empty session fixture in the verified temporary profile before sampling. No Electron source or persisted format is changed; default metadata remains in the temporary profile.
methodology.comparisonLimit: M0 has fewer features. Only these workloads are compared; video import/setup is excluded from stable sampling.
